data: Which of the plots shows the highest Jensen-Shannon Score value at 1 important feature?

The question asks which plot shows the highest Jensen-Shannon Score value at 1 important feature. From the caption, we know that the distance is generally smaller with post-hoc methods for all models, but there are some exceptions for LSTM with attention and BERT. The plots show the Jensen-Shannon Score values for different models across various numbers of important features. 

Looking at the plots:

- Plot (a): YELP
- Plot (b): SST
- Plot (c): Deception

At 1 important feature, the highest Jensen-Shannon Score value can be observed in Plot (b), which corresponds to the SST dataset. The line representing the BERT model with SHAP x background appears to have the highest value among all lines at this point.

Therefore, the answer is Plot (b), which corresponds to the SST dataset.
